name: Towa
source:
A girl who travels from country to country and reads her hand-drawn storybooks to children focused on the history and achievements of Arthur.

[spoiler]She is the daughter of a senator in Hamlet. She is traveling around the continent to collect money to help the hospitalized kids back in Hamlet, and to share her personal experiences of the outside world to those kids. She was sickly at a young age, so she spent a lot of time in the hospital.[/spoiler]
